name: 咲耶
text:
『信じた私が、馬鹿だった──なあ！』
『リーラァ！！』
trans:
"It was foolish to believe you... How dare you!"
"Lilas!!"

name: 咲耶
text:
（今のままでは、ただ私が台詞をなぞっているだけだ……
ディスティールとは言えない────）
trans:
(All I've been doing is reciting the lines...
Thistle would never say it like───)

name: 結華
text:
……──
──ねぇさくやーん、練習付き合ってー？
trans:
......──
──Hey, Sakuyan. Wanna practice?

name: 咲耶
text: ──っ、ああ、もちろん
trans: ──! Oh yes, of course.

name: 結華
text:
助かるよぉ
『まだ、さくやんのお芝居、覚えきれてなくて……』
trans:
Sweet! That helps, actually! I was all, "Man,
I haven't memorized all of Sakuyan's lines yet..."

name: 咲耶
text: フフ、結華はもうすっかりイーリスだね
trans: Hehe, you've fully become one with Iris now.

name: 結華
text:
いやいや全然！　イーリスさん、『三峰だったら
絶対それはやらないけど！？』みたいなこともするしねー
trans:
Oh no! Not even! Even Iris-san does things
that Mitsumine wouldn't even THINK of doing!

name: 咲耶
text:
ッ……！
そういう時はどうやって──！
trans:
...!
So what do you do for──

name: 咲耶
text:
……ぁ
すまない、その…………
trans:
Ack...
Sorry... Um...

name: 結華
text: ──どうやって気持ちに折り合いつけてる？　的な？
trans: ──for how to deal with it kind of thing?

name: 結華
text:
そういう時はねぇ
……『イーリスはそうなんだなぁ』って思ってるよ
trans:
I deal with it by thinking something like,
"Oh, that's just how Iris is" ...

name: 咲耶
trans: Huh...?

name: 結華
text:
もちろん同じ気持ちになれるのが一番いいんだろうけど！
でも難しい時もあるじゃん、別人だしね……！
trans:
Ideally, it'd be good if we felt the same way,
but it's hard isn't it? Because we're both
different people, right?

name: 結華
text:
そしたらもう、『同じ気持ちにはなれないけど、
そう思っちゃうのは理解できる』みたいな──
trans:
So then it became like, "I don't feel the same way,
 but I  can understand why you feel that way."

name: 結華
text: 歩み寄りでなんとかカバーする感じでさ……！
trans: I deal with it by meeting her half-way.

name: 結華
text:
必要なのはイーリスを100％表現することで、
100％イーリスと一致することじゃないと思うから
trans:
What's needed was to express Iris 100% of
the time, not to become her 100% of the time.

name: 咲耶
text: ……──、私は焦りすぎていたのかな
trans: ...Perhaps I was too fixated.

name: 結華
text:
責任感の人だからねぇ、座長さんは
リーラとの対決シーン？
trans:
It's the confrontation scene with Lilas, isn't it?
As the dutiful captain of the knights.

name: 咲耶
text: ああ
trans: Yeah.

name: 結華
text:
まぁ確かに、さくやんだったらで考えると
あのシーンで刺すところは想像できないもんね
trans:
Hm, yup. If I put myself in your shoes, I can't
imagine myself stabbing someone in that scene.

name: 咲耶
text: そうだね……けれど、もしかしたら──
trans: Yes... However... maybe we're actually──

name: 咲耶
text: 私たちは似た者同士なのかもしれない
trans: Maybe she and I are actually alike?

name: 咲耶
text:
『私なら刺せない』に固執して視野が狭くなっていた私、
吸血鬼殲滅以外の可能性に目を向けられないディスティール
trans:
I was so fixated on "not wanting to stab her," that I
lost sight of other options. Just like Thistle who
coudn't see any path beyond killing all vampires.

name: 咲耶
text: ──ほら、ね？
trans: ──isn't it the same?

name: 結華
text: おっ、さくやん余裕出てきた～？
trans: Ooo, seeing things more clearly, Sakuyan~?

name: 咲耶
text:
フフッ……
……──ねぇ結華
trans: Hehe... Hey, Yuika.

name: 咲耶
text: もしかして最初から、心配してくれていた？
trans:
Perhaps you were concerned for me from
start?

name: 結華
text:
こらー、今話したばっかでしょ
──三峰にも歩み寄って！
trans:
Hey now, didn't we talk about this? Don't jump to
that conclusion about Mitsumine either!
